_implementation_notes: SAFFRON CITY -- Phase 3 (Crisis). Maps 108, 152, 191.
Tone: Occupied territory. Corporate anxiety, whispered fear.
Saffron is under Rocket lockdown. Silph Co. is seized.
Map 108: Saffron City overworld. Rocket grunts rewritten as
three categories: True Believers (Mewtwo propaganda),
Enforcers (enjoying power), Reluctant Soldiers (humanized).
Post-Silph NPCs (switch 191) lightly adjusted for tone.
Blue/rival event 73 (switch 282) rewritten for Synthesis.
Map 152: Saffron City Gym. Sabrina (event 92) fully rewritten.
Pre-battle: prophet/test framing. Post-battle: Mewtwo hint.
Post-Silph page (switch 1152) added via insert_commands at
index 10 on page 1. Uses Switches 1150-1152, Variable 345.
Gym trainers rewritten to reflect Sabrina's anti-fusion stance.
Map 191: Fighting Dojo. Karate Master and fighters rewritten
as traditionalists -- anti-fusion but apolitical. Pocket of
normalcy in an occupied city. Hitmon gifts PRESERVED.
EXCLUDED: Silph Co. floors (SPECIAL_LOGIC, handled separately).
PRESERVED: Egg nest (77), invisible Pokemon (41), Mankey Paw
vendor (72), bar bouncer (47/58), bully trainer (60), signs.
Line length limit: ~42 characters per line for RPG Maker XP.
